instruction: Convert a VLC media file back into its original LibreOffice Impress presentation format with full editing capabilities.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because video files do not contain the structured data needed to reconstruct an editable presentation. VLC cannot reverse-engineer presentation elements from video frames.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly classified as infeasible - converting a video file back to an editable presentation format is technically impossible
Video format only contains rendered frames and audio, lacking the structural metadata (text objects, layers, formatting, animations) needed to reconstruct an editable presentation
The 'infeasible' evaluator function appropriately represents that no verification is possible for an impossible task
Metadata explanation correctly describes why the task cannot be completed
